description: Lookups, availability and booking cancellation stay free. Each agent identity gets 50 free tasks per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs 1 credit and a confirmed booking 5 credits. 1 credit = $0.10. Direct 100: 100 credits for $10; Direct 1,000: 1,000 credits for $90; Direct 10,000: 10,000 credits for $800. Credits never expire; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Existing prepaid dollar balances keep their full cent value; 10 cents of balance equals 1 credit. Price quotes and paying a quoted price are not available. The opt-in voice pilot costs 2.5 credits per answered minute, billed by the second with a 20-second minimum. It reserves a funded 20–600-second cap before dialing; failed and unanswered calls cost zero. It needs account opt-in; free-only connections cannot start voice. A wallet can pay $1.00 in Base USDC per answered call to a business (POST /a2a/v1/x402/call) or per answered test call of its own phone agent, with scores (POST /a2a/v1/x402/test-call); unanswered and failed calls are never charged. Send take_message, check_availability, book, book_first_available or cancel_booking. Cancellation requires data.booking_id and data.cancel_token from the confirmed booking, plus optional reason (up to 300 characters); it is free, uses no monthly allowance and does not refund the booking fee. Keep message_id unchanged on retry. Use target=claim for verified listings. Booking requires the human’s permission; pending deposits are charged only after calendar confirmation.
